title: Rosemary Beach "Living the Dream" 32 Rosemary Avenue- Main and Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Living the Dream" 32 Rosemary Avenue- Main and Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf Views- Spacious Porches and balconies- Carriage House- 6 Adult Bikes- Steps from Shopping and Dining - Short Walk to the Beach- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience Living the Dream in Rosemary Beach! Only a 2-minute stroll from the sugar-soft beach and turquoise Gulf, this 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom property is the ultimate Emerald Coast escape. Imagine savoring the coastal breeze from the wide porches and balconies, or taking in water views from the lookout tower. Comfortably accommodating 14 guests between the Main House and Carriage House, there’s room for the whole family or group to indulge. Guests will especially love access to the community’s numerous pools and nearby dining options for a convenient, carefree getaway! The sprawling Main House’s first level features a light-filled living space with 2 armchairs, 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds, 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds, and a convenient laundry room—so guests are always beach ready! Beautiful molding, stylish furnishings, and classic coastal design curate an elevated setting on the second-level. Sink into the soft couch and 2 plush armchairs surrounding the TV to unwind after a day in the sun. Right behind the couch, a wet bar provides quick refreshments, and a charming breakfast table features banquette seating and 3 chairs beneath a lavish chandelier. To the side, a round dining table for 8 separates the space from the kitchen, where high-end appliances and stunning blue cabinetry provide a picturesque backdrop for making gourmet meals. A window seat in the dining space and a cozy den with a loveseat and armchair offer additional spaces to relax indoors. Outside, 2 covered balconies with architectural columns, comfy seating, and peaceful views create a luxurious retreat—1 features a 2-person bistro set.The third floor hosts a wet bar and spacious primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and peek-a-boo Gulf views from the balcony.Take in the sweeping views of the water from the lookout tower’s comfy window seat or bar-top table for 4.The bright Carriage House offers extra space with a fully equipped kitchen, dining set, balcony, and 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds—1 is up the spiral staircase in an open, yet secluded loft. Visit Rosemary Beach and start Living the Dream! On-site parking and 6 complimentary adult bikes make exploring a breeze. For the nearest beach access, follow Rosemary Avenue, turn right onto South Green Turtle Lane, take another right at Water Street, and find the boardwalk in the middle of the block. Book today! Guests also have access to 4 or Rosemary's incredible pools, including the Coquina Pool, the Sky Pool, the Barbados Pool and the Cabana Pool. Five adult bikes are on hand to whisk you go and from the beach, amenities, and all of the wonderful shopping and dining opportunities. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and management fines.
